messages:
alex k: Quick check — POC for cost-aware router w/ gRPC primary + REST fallback. Proposal: route low-latency requests to quantized gRPC instances; if cost estimate or latency breaches, fallback to hosted REST variant.

maria r: sounds promising. Who enforces the quota/cost policy, gateway or origin service?

sam t: gateway IMHO. gives us single place to measure tokens and make binary decisions. also lets console show routing decisions per request.

alex k: sketch of policy config:

```
routing_policy:
  - id: cost_aware_v1
    match: tenant.tier == \"standard\"
    prefer: grpc://quantized-model.a:8500
    fallback: https://hosted.redwood/models/model-a/serve
    cost_threshold_per_token: \"0.0015\"
    batch_adjust: true
```

liz: note: batching changes effective cost. batch_adjust flag needs heuristic (avg tokens per batch) + sample window.

maria r: +1. also need an override for eval traffic so we don't throttle test runs.

infra-bot: deploy update: cost-router:v0.3 -> canary (5%) :rocket:

sam t: client libs for mobile sometimes don't support HTTP/2 gRPC well. gateway fallback reduces client complexity.

alex k: agree — gateway does TLS termination and handles alt protocols. it should add headers for observability:
  - X-Route-Selected
  - X-Model-Variant
  - X-Estimated-Tokens
  - X-Cost-Estimate

liz: telemetry plan: emit metrics: route.resolve.latency, route.resolve.cost_estimate, route.resolve.fallback.count with tags {tenant, route_id, variant}

maria r: console UX idea: when rolling out a new routing policy show a \"cost vs latency vs quality\" triangle, baseline vs canary. clickable link to sampled transcripts.

sam t: critical: if gateway rewrites payloads for fallback (proto->json), ensure we copy idempotency headers and client-provided request_id.

alex k: good call. Also record a small sample of model outputs for eval-set tagging so we can monitor quality regressions.

maria r: schedule a 20-min demo Friday? want to see the metric dashboards & a canary trace.

sam t: I'll pull proto->json benchmark numbers — saw ~30-60ms overhead for some models. keep that in the rollout plan.

alex k: thanks — I'll wire up the policy prototype, + canary config. tagging everyone who volunteered: maria r, sam t, liz :thumbsup:
